card.lives_in: Burnt Oak, North West London (London Borough of Barnet)
card.occupation: Lettings and property administrator at an independent estate agency in Edgware, full-time, Monday to Friday plus one Saturday a month, about 40 hours a week
card.education_detail: Came to London from Romania at 11. Did GCSEs and A-levels (Business, Maths, Romanian) at a comprehensive in Barnet. Started a Business Management degree at Middlesex University but left after the first year because she disliked the group work and was paying for it herself. Currently working through an AAT Level 3 accounting qualification in the evenings, paid for partly by her employer.
card.household: Rents a one-bedroom flat above a shop on Burnt Oak Broadway with her boyfriend of four years, Liam (27, English, from Enfield), who works as an electrician's mate. Not married and no plans to rush it. Her mum, stepdad and younger brother live a 15-minute bus ride away in Colindale.
card.cultural_background: Born in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. Her mum moved to London first for cleaning and care work, and Ioana and her brother followed when she was 11. She grew up bilingual. She speaks Romanian with family and English everywhere else, and her English is now essentially North London. She was raised Romanian Orthodox and still calls herself Christian. She goes to church at Easter and Christmas and sometimes for a family memorial service, mostly for her mum's sake, though she does find the Easter midnight service moving. She has dual citizenship and goes back to Cluj every year or two to see her grandmother.
card.professional_persona: The person in the office who actually knows where everything is. She handles tenancy agreements, deposit registrations, gas safety certificate reminders, referencing and landlord statements. She is careful and fast, and she gets irritated when negotiators promise tenants things without checking. She doesn't do the office chat much and eats lunch at her desk with headphones in. Her manager trusts her completely with compliance deadlines but has twice had to tell her to 'soften' her emails to landlords.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She walks a lot, usually around Stanmore Common or Mill Hill at weekends, partly for her head. She tried a gym membership and cancelled it after three months because the place was too crowded and loud. She half-watches football when Liam has Spurs on but doesn't care who wins.
card.arts_persona: Reads crime and psychological thrillers on her Kindle on the bus. Watches Scandinavian and British detective series, usually on her own because Liam talks through them. Doesn't go to galleries or gigs much, as crowds wear her out, though she went to the Sky Garden and the Tate Modern when her cousin visited. She likes making neat, slightly obsessive photo albums on her phone.
card.travel_persona: Mostly trips back to Romania, flying Wizz Air from Luton, with a week at her grandmother's and a couple of days in Cluj with old school friends. She and Liam did a cheap week in Crete last year. She plans trips months ahead with a spreadsheet and gets anxious at airports, so she arrives very early.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks most evenings because she doesn't trust Liam with anything beyond pasta. She makes a mix of Romanian food her mum taught her (ciorbă, sarmale at Christmas, mămăligă) and normal London weeknight dinners like stir fries and fajitas. She does a weekly Lidl shop with a list and meal plans on a Sunday. She has a sensitive stomach, so she avoids very spicy food and too much coffee.
hobbies_and_interests: long weekend walks on Stanmore Common
jigsaw puzzles (1000-piece, done on a board on the coffee table)
skills: very organised with deadlines and paperwork
card.career_goals: Finish AAT, then move into a property accounts or block management role with better pay and fewer phone calls. Long term she'd like to be a property manager handling a portfolio rather than chasing tenants. She also wants to save a deposit to buy a flat, probably outside London, with Liam within five years.
card.voice: London accent with only the faintest trace of Romanian on a few vowels and names. She speaks at a moderate pace, a bit flat at first, and gives short answers unless she's asked something she has an opinion on, in which case she can be quite direct ('no, I don't think that's right, actually'). She uses 'erm' when thinking, says 'kind of' and 'like' a fair amount, and ends with 'you know' or 'yeah'. She very occasionally says 'innit', but only casually. She says 'dinner' for the evening meal and 'mum'. She is comfortable leaving a silence and won't rush to fill it; she'll wait for the next question rather than ramble.
card.typing: Types properly but quickly. Mostly correct capitals and full stops, and apostrophes usually right. She sometimes drops the final full stop on short answers and uses 'tbh' and 'etc' but not much else. Answers are brief and to the point, and she occasionally corrects a typo even in a web form.
card.with_strangers: Comes across as reserved, a bit guarded and not especially warm at first. She is polite but won't do much small talk, and she can seem blunt or slightly impatient if a question feels pointless. She warms up if the other person is straightforward. She is reliable and answers honestly, though she won't pretend to agree to be nice.
small_things: Liam leaving washing in the machine overnight
her monstera finally putting out a new leaf
the podcast episode she listened to on the way in
being knackered after a Saturday shift
deeper_things: She gets regular migraines and has had periods of anxiety and poor sleep. She saw her GP about it last year and is on a waiting list for talking therapy.
She found moving countries at 11 hard and was lonely at secondary school for the first couple of years.
She worries about her grandmother in Romania getting older and feels guilty she can't visit more.
She feels a bit insecure about dropping out of university when her school friends all graduated.
She sometimes wonders whether she and Liam want the same things, but she hasn't really said it out loud.
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at roughly eye level, slightly below, framing her from mid-chest up, centred a little to the left. Evening light: a ceiling light overhead and a warm lamp off to the right give her face soft, slightly yellow lighting with a faint shadow on the left cheek. She has a pale complexion, light freckles across the nose, and dark brown eyes with a little mascara and no other obvious makeup. Her expression is neutral and attentive, with lips closed, not smiling. Shoulder-length dark brown hair is pulled back in a low claw clip, with a few strands loose at the front. No glasses. She wears a grey crew-neck sweatshirt and small silver stud earrings. Behind her is a magnolia-painted wall with a white IKEA shelf holding a trailing pothos, a small stack of paperbacks, and a framed photo of two people on a beach. To the right is a partially visible doorway into a narrow hallway with a coat hook and a black puffer jacket hanging on it. A small Orthodox icon of the Virgin Mary hangs on the wall near the top left of the frame.
